notes.title: Official Version Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Official Version Update[/b][/h1]

Dear Players,

We sincerely thank you for your continuous support and love! With everyone's encouragement, we are thrilled to announce that the game "Inari" has officially been released! In the official version, we have added many new systems and fully optimized the game content to bring you a more colorful and enriched gaming experience. At the same time, we have fixed some issues from the early access phase, hoping to provide you with a smoother and more comfortable gaming environment.

The growth of "Inari" would not have been possible without the sincere feedback and valuable suggestions from every player. Your support is our driving force to move forward! Once again, thank you for your trust and love!

[h1][b]Main Update Content[/b][/h1]

 - Treasure Stories: Explore the stories behind the treasures, solve puzzles to find the truth, and obtain the precious treasures that are hard to find.
 - Endings: Each heroine has a unique ending. Increase their affection, and the fruits of your bonds with them will bloom.
 - Multiple Interactions: Through events, dates, and other rich forms of interaction, establish deeper bonds with your favorite heroine.
 - Costume: Three brand-new and elegant outfits have been added, giving the heroines more charm.
 - Free H Mode: More poses and scenes have been added, providing you with richer choices and sensory experiences.
 - Housework System: The housework system has been completely revamped, making it more convenient to operate, with richer rewards.
 - Difficulty System: A "cheat mode" has been added, allowing you to enjoy the game more easily. (Note: Some achievements may be unattainable.)
 - Skill System: New skills await your exploration, offering you a better gaming experience.
 - Achievements: About 15 new achievements have been added, waiting for you to challenge.

[h2][b]New Treasure Stories[/b][/h2]

The treasure stories are divided into four chapters.
Collect three treasure fragments to fulfill your final wish.
Complete the treasure stories to receive rich rewards.
Specific conditions must be met to unlock each chapter.
 - Chapter 0: Complete the beach cleaning
 - Chapter 1: Any heroine's affection reaches 60
 - Chapter 2: Become a "lover" with any heroine
 - Chapter 3: Any heroine's affection reaches 160

[h2][b]New Endings[/b][/h2]

Takane, Asami, Mio have their own exclusive endings.
Increase their affection to unlock their endings!

[h2][b]New Multiple Interactions[/b][/h2]

Dates:
Several new date locations have been added.

Events:
Several new in-game events have been added, and selecting the right options can increase the heroine's affection.

[h2][b]New Clothing[/b][/h2]

New:
Three new outfits

Clothing types:
Bikini, Casual wear, Yukata

Unlock condition:
Find the corresponding treasure to unlock.

[h2][b]Expanded Free H Mode[/b][/h2]

New:
More poses and scenes

[h2][b]Improved Housework System[/b][/h2]

The housework system has been greatly optimized.
Reduced the number of items required and the pressure in mini-game tasks.
Upgrading skills can improve housework efficiency.
Completing housework will reward you with heroine affection and money.

[h2][b]New Difficulty System[/b][/h2]

New Difficulty:
Cheat mode
In cheat mode, affection and money acquisition speed are increased by 1.5x, and initial funds are set at 100,000 yen. (Using cheat mode will make some achievements unattainable.)

[h2][b]Improved Skill System[/b][/h2]

Enhancements:
Increased affection skill effects
Improved fishing skill effects

Other adjustments:
Skill prices and effects
Changes to the housework system skill functions
Changes to hotel part-time job skill functions

[h2][b]New Achievements[/b][/h2]

New achievements:
Approximately 15 new achievements
Including endings, heroine, fishing, skills, and more.

notes.title: New Patch News + Question & Answer
notes.content:
[h1][b]<New Patch News>[/b][/h1]

Hello.
First of all, thank you for your interest in Inari.
We have been continuously preparing updates.

With this update, the official release is expected to take place.
We are preparing quite a lot of content for the update.

The update is expected to be released at the end of August.

Now, let me tell you about the contents of this update.

[h3]1. Main Story Addition + Ending[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/4cf798dfc26a55cfb6278a1195dbbb0b2729e606.png[/img]
Finally, the story about the treasure comes to a conclusion.
Collect all the treasures and see a special ending.

[h3]2. New Outfit Addition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/6d866d7c98b40a58e46f0d89db432e4f60b573ae.jpg[/img]
The new outfits that you have been waiting for a long time are here.
A total of 3 new outfits are being added.
Enjoy the bikini, yukata, and other new outfits.

[h3]3. New Free H Mode Addition[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/ac60b35795131cee0f367c920c7271f29faa3c15.png[/img]
New poses and various modes matching the new outfits are being added.
Please look forward to the newly added features.

[h3]4. Russian Language Addition[/h3]

Finally, a new language, Russian, is being added.
We used a translation tool but have tried our best to proofread it.
We will continue to strive for better service.

[h3]5. Various Event Additions[/h3]

Many new quests and events have been added.
Look forward to more dates and sweet moments with the heroines.

[h3]6. Mini-Game Difficulty Easing and Convenience Items Addition[/h3]

We received feedback that the mini-games felt repetitive or tiring.
We have listened to the feedback and eased the difficulty and added convenience items.
We will continue to actively incorporate feedback.

There are many other updates as well, so please look forward to them.
Thank you for waiting for a long time.
We will do our best not to disappoint you.

[h1][b]<Question & Answer>[/b][/h1]

Q: Will Free H Mode be added for sub-heroines as well?
A: We are considering it. Depending on the performance after the official release, it may be updated more quickly.

Q: Is there no additional H-scene for the main heroine?
A: A new H-scene has been added to this ending.

Q: Will the Fishing Shop (Aoi) be added as a heroine?
A: This is certainly a lower priority. If a DLC is added, we will definitely consider it.

Q: Will an automatic dialogue playback feature be added?
A: We will definitely add it in the next update.

Q: Will it be possible to change the protagonist's name?
A: We will definitely add it in the next update.

Q: Is full voice acting planned?
A: Due to budget issues, full voice acting is difficult for this project. We will try our best for the next project.

Q: What is the suspicious black box?
A: You can find out with this update.

Thank you, we will strive to return as soon as possible.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Sub-Heroines
notes.content:
Hello! This is HimitsuCP from Inari Studio.

There seems to be some confusion regarding the sub-heroines, so we are posting this announcement.

Currently, there are four sub-heroines.
Ando, Sayaka, Julia, Rin
Each heroine has five H-scenes, and you need to complete two mini-games and three quests to see all the scenes.

Here are the conditions for each heroine's appearance and detailed information.

[h2][b]1. Vegetable Garden - Ando[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/df38d6fe5f0856e953c734e228bca1dea8c78c34.png[/img]

Ando is the first heroine you meet in the vegetable garden.
Help her catch the bugs that appear in the garden.

Ando Appearance Conditions:
- After 10 days of gameplay.
- The shrine must be open.
- After meeting the above conditions, she appears in the evening.

[h2][b]2. Hotel - Sayaka[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/621bb2b5a89233e0fa2f6467bb700b4b358461c9.png[/img]

Sayaka is the owner of the hotel.
She appears aloof and cold, but she is a woman with many secrets.
Try to win her over.

Sayaka Appearance Conditions:
- After 15 days of gameplay.
- Ando must be activated.
- Aoi's fishing shop must be open.
- After meeting the above conditions, she appears during the day.

[h2][b]3. Beach - Julia[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/204583324535104fec0a303aa947c969148067a8.png[/img]

Julia is a lifeguard working at the beach.
Help her deal with the jellyfish.
Something good is sure to happen.

Julia Appearance Conditions:
- After 20 days of gameplay.
- Sayaka must be activated.
- Carrot Island must be open.
- After meeting the above conditions, she appears in the morning.

[h2][b]4. Shrine - Rin[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/bd2d705d2dd869fc573f472ae2758a950060b6ab.png[/img]

Rin is another guardian deity at the shrine.
Help her.
She can grant all your wishes.

Rin Appearance Conditions:
- After 25 days of gameplay.
- Julia must be activated.
- After meeting the above conditions, she appears at night.

P.S.
After this patch, the shrine is closed again.
Please clean the shrine once more.
A different reward awaits you.

The conditions may be a bit challenging.
But if you play the game slowly, you can see everything. Hang in there!

Thank you for patiently waiting for this patch.

We will work on the treasure hunt story as quickly as possible to present it to you.

notes.title: About Updates and Current Bugs...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/720fc06cea0c947887906343c4b0ffe2229d2840.png[/img]
Hello, this is HimitsuCP, the developer of Inari.

April has passed, and it's now May.
Inari is also approaching its official release.
Today's news is about upcoming updates and some prevalent bugs.

[h1][b]1. Sub-Heroine Update[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/bfc2df385ae15225bd33fc0f73eaf6ea6e104de8.jpg[/img]
Many have been awaiting the sub-heroine update, which is as follows.
First, the update is expected around the end of May.
We apologize for the delay, as the volume of content has increased more than anticipated.

Each sub-heroine will have a total of 5 scenes,
and related quests will also be added.

We promise to do our best to deliver a high-quality update by the end of May.

[h1][b]2. Bug Where the Game Does Not Start[/b][/h1]

First, we apologize for any inconvenience in gameplay.

The cause of the bug is due to memory overload.

The increased memory usage compared to the initial version has led to a bug where the game stops running.
Therefore, we have changed the minimum memory specification from 4GB to 8GB.

Inari is developed using the game development program, Unity.
Unity has a program for compressing resources.
This program shows high memory usage.

If this program is not used,
Inari's storage usage would be about 15GB.

Inari uses high-quality resources to provide a good experience.
Therefore, an increase in memory usage or storage usage is an unavoidable necessity.
We are working to improve this situation as much as possible.

We apologize again for any inconvenience in using the game.

tags.bug: The cause of the bug is due to memory overload.
The increased memory usage compared to the initial version has led to a bug where the game stops running.

notes.title: Previewing Game Patch News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/720fc06cea0c947887906343c4b0ffe2229d2840.png[/img]
Hello.
April 2024 is already passing by.

Inari is diligently preparing for the official release.
We will work hard to provide you with a better game.

First, let me tell you about the upcoming patches.

1. Free H Mode Patch

I believe this is one of the patches many players are waiting for.

With the addition of Free H Mode, H interactions will be added with the heroine.
That means players can initiate H interactions with the heroine whenever they want.

This patch is scheduled for the end of April.

2. Sub-Heroine Patch

I think this is the patch you are all most excited about.

The stories of 4 sub-heroines will be unlocked.
Each story consists of 5 scenes.
We will provide you with good stories worth the wait.

This patch is expected to happen in mid-May.

3. Heroine Interaction Improvement

The way to court the heroine will be improved.

We thought the existing method of just building up affection was monotonous.
We plan to add more diverse interactions.

If you go on a date, we will add corresponding event cutscenes.
Or after giving a gift, the heroine may carry the item around or set up the gift in her room.

We will try to enhance the real dating simulation feel.

This patch is also expected in mid-May.

4. Official Release

Finally, the official release.

You will be able to see the game's ending and create more memories with the heroines.
You may find the Golden Fox Award or lose everything.

Please check for more details after the patch.

The official release is expected in the last week of June.

This is our patch plan in preparation.

It may be slightly delayed or brought forward.

We will do our best to provide a better game.
Thank you always for your interest.

And thank you to YarXVI and SHINKU who have always helped us.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/720fc06cea0c947887906343c4b0ffe2229d2840.png[/img]
[h1][b]1. Quest Notification Feature Improvement[/b][/h1]
The previous patch introduced many new quests. However, it was difficult for players to know where these quests were located.

To improve this, we have updated the map to display notifications where quests are triggered.

Some quests were found to be too difficult. To address this issue, we have added a quest hint feature.

Crucial hints have been added to quests that received many inquiries, so do not hesitate to check the hints.

The Quest Helper can be accessed in the quest window.

We will continue to work hard to ensure that our players can enjoy an even more fun gaming experience.
Thank you. :)

notes.title: Ver 1.2.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/720fc06cea0c947887906343c4b0ffe2229d2840.png[/img]
Greetings! We are HimitsuCP, the developers of Inari. 
Thank you for your patience in waiting for the patch.

Let us introduce the contents of this update.

[h1][b]1. Improved Translations[/b][/h1]
We have improved the translations based on feedback from many of you. 
This effort to enhance translations will continue. 
Please look forward to a better quality of translation than before. 

We especially want to express our gratitude to our friend, SHINKU, who assisted with the Chinese translation. 
As a fan of Inari, he has shown tremendous affection. 
No amount of thanks can suffice; we are truly grateful.

[h1][b]2. Addition of CCTV Functionality[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/874bc4f36c15c5668438a5ba034c4bf8b2d0e02b.jpg[/img]
You can now install CCTV in bathrooms and restrooms. 
Observe them through the CCTV. 

For more entertaining scenes, consider using aphrodisiacs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/ffb090ee4364b13d6ace63da35e8733a121ae3be.jpg[/img]
You can now capture the appearances of women located at the beach and hotel swimming pools in photos. 
Use special cameras to discreetly photograph them.

[h1][b]4. New NPCs & Spot Changes[/b][/h1]
Various new NPCs have been added. 
You can receive a variety of new quests from them. 

Spots have also been beautified. 
Take a look around the transformed spots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/d9d52728b1c1ab68072e66b03088ceaf57c0aca5.jpg[/img]
A small shop located at the fishing spot has finally opened. 
Help Aoi normalize the shop. 

Once the shop is normalized, you can receive fun fishing quests.

P.S.)
This patch focuses on improving game playability. 

We plan to add a variety of quests and interactive elements moving forward. 

Updates will continue steadily.
Please look forward to the evolving game. 
We apologize for not communicating more frequently due to being busy. 

We are always grateful for the love and support from our users. Thank you very much.

Fixed a bug that stopped playing on the beach

Corrections are completed after identifying the cause of a multi-lingual problem

In addition, we have fixed another small bugs.
Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience caused.

We'll let you know about the additional revisions.

<Additional applications>
 - Adjust detector probabilities
We have adjusted the probability of rare items appearing.
 - Ring item sale
We have modified the rings related to the lover system to be sold in stores.
The ring appears in the store after you get your first ring.
 - Modify the Heroine Information Window
The H scenes that have been added now can only be seen as lovers.
Additional UI has been applied to the Heroine Information window for easy recognition.

If there are any other inconveniences, we will try to respond as soon as possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: Localization modify update!
notes.content:
< Localization modify update! >

Hello, users! 

We, HimitsuCP has collaborated with several translation companies and experts to localize them

But, we don't think we've been able to provide a good play experience to the users

So, we've updated it to make easy to modify in-game text.

We hope this update will be a better play experience for users.

The basic language of the game is Korean.

* How to modify

1. Go to the game folder -> LocalizeData folder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/326c9a49e3a8aa801e4ca39851f930890f732e83.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/7cc65dc42e64f3805e29035fed313891273f96a2.jpg[/img]

2. Navigate to the language folder you want to modify.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/e0f44a5fd87f9920e4d980ab8c9cd847090b5ada.jpg[/img]

3. Open the text file you want to modify and modify it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/5debfb4d4590169ed9d4d5f164d52c936edce9f6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/312de03bd7a400532c7082a2e79dbfd70c0c2e7d.jpg[/img]

4. Run the game to see if it's applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721547/286aa791db60be8ec0304d21c96ed56618ed300b.jpg[/img]


* Caution

1. Existing text may be forced to change when updating in the future.

2. Errors may occur when applying text that does not fit the form.


* When error occurred

1. Delete the modified file or language folder.
   - At this time, we recommend that you back up the modified file to another path if you want to preserve it.

2. Start game and new default file will be created.

tags.feature: So, we've updated it to make easy to modify in-game text.
